title: Write-amplification-triggered eviction cascade in KV cache under small-batch loads
creator: Mateo Alvarez
description: Customer and internal load tests showed recurring latency spikes and transient OOMs on inference nodes during a pattern of high small-batch writes (~100-500 short KV entries/sec) interleaved with reads. Investigation indicates a write-amplification behavior in the KV cache compaction/insert path that temporarily inflates resident set size and increases eviction churn, causing eviction cascades across shards and tenant namespaces. This ticket tracks investigation artifacts, decisions, and action items to mitigate recurrence and reduce blast radius.
impact_summary: Observed 6 incidents across 4 clusters over two weeks; peak 20% increase in p99 latency and two customer workloads experienced degraded throughput for ~15 minutes. No data loss, but increased tail latency and a forced autoscaler scale-up cost impact.
root_cause: A combination of factors: (1) small-batch insertion pattern caused repeated short-lived allocations in per-shard slab arenas; (2) async compaction was scheduled aggressively for these small allocations leading to temporary slab fragmentation; (3) our eviction scoring favored last-access-time and did not account for recent small-write amplification, causing hot entries to be evicted and reinserted repeatedly; (4) lack of a rate-limiter on background compaction tasks allowed compaction to interfere with foreground IO under load.

action_items: ENG-557901-A1: Implement compaction backpressure — add adaptive rate limiter to compaction workers to yield under sustained small-batch write rates (owner: Emily Chen, ETA: 2026-03-12)
ENG-557901-A2: Adjust eviction scoring to penalize repeated reinsertions — add a short-term reinsertion suppression factor to eviction score calculation (owner: Marcus Li, ETA: 2026-03-18)
ENG-557901-A3: Add per-tenant small-write hotspot telemetry — histogram of insert size / per-second write bursts surfaced to Console (owner: Priya Nair, ETA: 2026-03-10)
ENG-557901-A4: Temporary mitigation rollout — default compaction concurrency reduced from 4 -> 1 for Dedicated clusters and Private images; monitor for regressions (owner: SRE Team, ETA: 2026-03-05)
ENG-557901-A5: Stress test suite addition — add mixed small-write/read scenarios to CI perf lab and gate for regressions (owner: QA, ETA: 2026-03-22)
ENG-557901-A6: Post-deploy verification playbook — create a runbook to validate compaction/backpressure behavior and memory stability after rollout (owner: Emily Chen, ETA: 2026-03-14)
ENG-557901-A7: Telemetry alerting — create an alert that triggers when eviction churn rate > 1000 evictions/minute sustained for 5 minutes (owner: Observability, ETA: 2026-03-11)
ENG-557901-A8: Long-term allocator review — evaluate alternative slab sizing heuristics and smart decoupling of compaction from small allocation churn (owner: Runtime Team, ETA: 2026-04-05)
ENG-557901-A9: Customer communication — notify affected customers of follow-up fixes and provide temporary knobs to opt into reduced compaction concurrency (owner: Customer Success, ETA: 2026-03-12)
ENG-557901-A10: Postmortem doc and retention — finalize incident report with root cause analysis and link in incidents playbook (owner: Mateo Alvarez, ETA: 2026-03-10)
ENG-557901-A11: Dependency audit — check interaction points with prefix-cache index reconciliation and ensure no overlapping compaction triggers (owner: Anya Petrova, ETA: 2026-03-16)
decisions: 1) Short-term: throttle compaction concurrency in affected environments to prioritize foreground read/write latency over background compaction throughput
2) Medium-term: implement adaptive compaction backpressure and eviction scoring changes to reduce reinsert churn
3) Long-term: investigate allocator redesign and per-tenant isolation knobs to reduce cross-tenant blast radius
monitoring_and_alerting: Added eviction-churn dashboard panel: evictions_per_minute by shard and tenant
Added per-tenant write-burst histogram to Console and perf-lab dashboards
New alert: eviction_churn_sustained (threshold: 1000/min over 5m) routed to oncall and runtime channel
Memory growth probe: track resident set delta over 10-minute windows and alert if > 15% increase
rollout_plan: Canary: deploy compaction backpressure to staging and one non-critical Dedicated pool (2 nodes) and run synthetic small-batch workload for 24h
Ramp: if canary stable, roll changes to 25% of Dedicated capacity over 48h while monitoring eviction churn and p99 latency
Full rollout: after 72h stable at 25% and no regression signals, deploy globally with 10-minute staggered waves
Fallback: revert compaction backpressure and reapply reduced concurrency cap if regressions observed
notes: Emily paired with Marcus on a prototype for reinsertion suppression; early perf tests show 30-50% reduction in eviction churn under synthetic load
We observed that some Private deployments had custom compaction knobs; Customer Success will coordinate with enterprise customers before changing defaults
Follow-up review scheduled for 2026-03-21 to validate long-term allocator proposals
